prompt:
Two problems found running Auto with a decider through more harnesses.

1. The first decider call from a fresh daemon can take several seconds. Today `primeAutoDecider` gives up when the configured wait (`timeoutMs`) runs out, aborts the request and caches "no answer" for the prompt, so the same hard prompt then goes to the fast tier for minutes. Change it so the turn still waits only `timeoutMs`, but a request that has not answered by then keeps running in the background: `decidedDifficulty` returns undefined for that turn, a later `primeAutoDecider` call for the same prompt must not start a second request, and when the answer arrives it is cached and used from the next turn. A request that never answers is abandoned after a hard limit of 20 seconds and recorded as "no answer". Tests override that limit through a `hardTimeoutMs` field on the context object passed to `primeAutoDecider`. Also have the daemon make one small decider call in the background when a session that has a decider registers, so the user's first prompt is not the cold one.

2. In the chat-completions passthrough (`resolveAutoRequest` in packages/cli/src/lib/daemon/chat-passthrough.ts), a request under Auto that offers the model no tools is the harness's own utility call (DeepSeek Harness asks for a session title this way), not an agent turn. It is currently judged like a task. Such a request must go to the fast model with the decision `{ tier: "fast", reason: "harness_call" }`, and must not be shown to a decider.

This is a pnpm monorepo. Run one test file with `cd packages/tests && node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/<file>.test.ts`; do not run the whole suite. packages/cli imports @nconnect/models from its build output, so after changing packages/models run `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/models/tsconfig.json` from the repository root. Dependencies are already installed: never run pnpm, npm or any install command. Do not bump versions or edit CHANGELOG or the site/ folder.
